scripts.build: npm run build:pricing-backend && tsc -b && vite build --configLoader runner
scripts.emulators: npm run build:pricing-backend && node scripts/emulator-data.mjs start
scripts.test:auth: node scripts/prepare-isolated-regressions.mjs enabled && playwright test --config tmp/isolated-regressions-enabled/playwright.config.ts --output tmp/auth-test-results
scripts.test:signup-disabled: node scripts/prepare-isolated-regressions.mjs disabled && playwright test --config tmp/isolated-regressions-disabled/playwright.config.ts --output tmp/signup-disabled-results
scripts.build:pricing-backend: node scripts/build-pricing-backend.mjs && node --check functions/index.mjs && node --check functions/timekeeping.mjs && node --check functions/financial.mjs && node --check functions/pricingValidation.mjs && node --check functions/authorization.mjs && node --check functions/employees.mjs && node --check functions/technicianJobs.mjs && node --check functions/accounting.mjs && node --check functions/quickbooksMock.mjs && node --check functions/integrations.mjs && node --check functions/integrationCore.mjs && node --check functions/operationalService.mjs && node --check functions/dispatch.mjs && node --check functions/workOrderCommands.mjs
scripts.emulators:pricing: npm run build:pricing-backend && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-orvex-phase3c-tests --config firebase.phase3c-test.json
scripts.test:pricing: npm run build:pricing-backend && node scripts/run-phase3c-tests.mjs && playwright test --config emulator-tests/pricing.config.ts --output tmp/phase3c-browser-results
scripts.emulators:time: npm run build:pricing-backend && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-orvex-phase3d-tests --config firebase.phase3d-test.json
scripts.test:time: npm run build:pricing-backend && node --test emulator-tests/time-model.test.mjs emulator-tests/time-backend.test.mjs
scripts.test:finance: npm run build:pricing-backend && node scripts/wait-financial-emulators.mjs && node --test emulator-tests/financial-model.test.mjs emulator-tests/financial-backend.test.mjs
scripts.emulators:finance: npm run build:pricing-backend && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-orvex-phase3c-tests --config firebase.phase3c-test.json
scripts.test:finance:compat: node scripts/prepare-phase3e-compatibility.mjs && node --test emulator-tests/time-model.test.mjs tmp/phase3e-compatibility/time-backend.test.mjs && playwright test --config tmp/phase3e-compatibility/playwright.config.ts --output tmp/phase3e-time-browser
scripts.test:employees: npm run build:pricing-backend && node scripts/wait-financial-emulators.mjs && node --test emulator-tests/employees.test.mjs
scripts.test:accounting: npm run build:pricing-backend && node scripts/wait-financial-emulators.mjs && node --test emulator-tests/accounting.test.mjs
scripts.test:integrations: npm run build:pricing-backend && node scripts/wait-financial-emulators.mjs && node --test emulator-tests/integrations.test.mjs
scripts.test:dispatch: npm run build:pricing-backend && node scripts/wait-financial-emulators.mjs && node --test emulator-tests/dispatch-model.test.mjs emulator-tests/dispatch.test.mjs
